summary: MaxsMaking Inc., a Shanghai-based miscellaneous fabricated textile products manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current/interim report) covering the fiscal period ended April 30, 2026; the exhibit set is dominated by financial statements and XBRL detail rather than any transaction announcement. Disclosed items are ordinary-course: bank loan agreements and short-term borrowings with Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of Communications, NingBo Bank, Zhejiang Yiwu Rural Commercial Bank and Mintai Commercial Bank, related-party guarantees, lease and equipment schedules. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private or capital-return event appears; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
